sin.name: work-mode-asked
sin.description: A state or a conduct asks which work mode holds, even in one if, and decides what to say by it: the line belongs to that mode's state.
sin.rule: Move the line onto the work mode's state as its mode conduct; a state or a conduct never asks which mode holds, since the mode's state is on the stack and answers for itself. A write the journal makes by the mode stays in its recording listener.
